requirements.quote:
The payload of QUIC packets, after removing packet protection,
   consists of a sequence of complete frames, as shown in Figure 11.
   Version Negotiation, Stateless Reset, and Retry packets do not
   contain frames.
requirements.condition: After packet protection is removed from a QUIC packet other than Version Negotiation, Stateless Reset, or Retry
requirements.required_behavior: Interpret the packet payload as a sequence of complete frames.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not encode or accept a frame that is only partially contained in the payload.
requirements.why_checkable: Packet parsing can verify that the protected payload decodes entirely into complete frames.

requirements.quote:
The payload of QUIC packets, after removing packet protection,
   consists of a sequence of complete frames, as shown in Figure 11.
   Version Negotiation, Stateless Reset, and Retry packets do not
   contain frames.
requirements.condition: For Version Negotiation, Stateless Reset, or Retry packets
requirements.why_checkable: Packet generation and parsing tests can inspect whether these packet types contain frames.

requirements.quote:
The payload of a packet that contains frames MUST contain at least
   one frame, and MAY contain multiple frames and multiple frame types.
requirements.condition: When a packet payload is of a form that contains frames
requirements.required_behavior: Contain at least one frame; multiple frames and multiple frame types are permitted.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not produce an empty frame sequence.
requirements.why_checkable: The decoded frame count and represented frame types can be inspected directly.

requirements.quote:
An endpoint MUST treat receipt of a packet containing no frames as a
   connection error of type PROTOCOL_VIOLATION.  Frames always fit
   within a single QUIC packet and cannot span multiple packets.
requirements.condition: When an endpoint receives a packet of a form that contains frames but the packet contains no frames
requirements.error_behavior: Treat receipt as a connection error of type PROTOCOL_VIOLATION.
requirements.why_checkable: A zero-frame packet can be injected and the resulting connection error code observed.

requirements.quote:
An endpoint MUST treat receipt of a packet containing no frames as a
   connection error of type PROTOCOL_VIOLATION.  Frames always fit
   within a single QUIC packet and cannot span multiple packets.
requirements.condition: For every encoded frame
requirements.required_behavior: Fit the entire frame within one QUIC packet.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not span a frame across multiple packets.
requirements.why_checkable: Packet boundaries and frame encoding boundaries can be compared.

requirements.quote:
Each frame begins with a Frame Type, indicating its type, followed by
   additional type-dependent fields:
requirements.condition: When encoding or decoding any frame
requirements.required_behavior: Place the Frame Type first, followed by the fields defined for that frame type.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not place type-dependent fields before the Frame Type.
requirements.why_checkable: The field order is directly observable in serialized frames.

requirements.quote:
The Frame Type in ACK, STREAM, MAX_STREAMS, STREAMS_BLOCKED, and
   CONNECTION_CLOSE frames is used to carry other frame-specific flags.
   For all other frames, the Frame Type field simply identifies the
   frame.
requirements.condition: For ACK, STREAM, MAX_STREAMS, STREAMS_BLOCKED, and CONNECTION_CLOSE frames
requirements.required_behavior: Use the Frame Type to carry the frame-specific flags in addition to identifying the frame.
requirements.why_checkable: Implementations can be tested for decoding the defined type variants as flag-bearing values.

requirements.quote:
The Frame Type in ACK, STREAM, MAX_STREAMS, STREAMS_BLOCKED, and
   CONNECTION_CLOSE frames is used to carry other frame-specific flags.
   For all other frames, the Frame Type field simply identifies the
   frame.
requirements.condition: For frame types other than ACK, STREAM, MAX_STREAMS, STREAMS_BLOCKED, and CONNECTION_CLOSE
requirements.required_behavior: Use the Frame Type field solely to identify the frame.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not interpret the Frame Type value as carrying frame-specific flags.
requirements.why_checkable: Frame-type decoding logic can be inspected or exercised to determine whether extra flag semantics are assigned.

requirements.condition: When the Frame Type value is 0x00
requirements.why_checkable: The type-to-frame-name mapping is a fixed value that can be tested during decoding.

requirements.condition: When the Frame Type value is 0x01
requirements.why_checkable: The type-to-frame-name mapping is a fixed value that can be tested during decoding.

requirements.condition: When the Frame Type value is in the range 0x02 through 0x03
requirements.why_checkable: Both values in the fixed range can be supplied to the frame decoder.

requirements.condition: When the Frame Type value is 0x04
requirements.why_checkable: The type-to-frame-name mapping is directly testable.

requirements.condition: When the Frame Type value is 0x05
requirements.why_checkable: The type-to-frame-name mapping is directly testable.

requirements.condition: When the Frame Type value is 0x06
requirements.why_checkable: The type-to-frame-name mapping is directly testable.

requirements.condition: When the Frame Type value is 0x07
requirements.why_checkable: The type-to-frame-name mapping is directly testable.

requirements.condition: When the Frame Type value is in the range 0x08 through 0x0f
requirements.why_checkable: Every value in the fixed range can be supplied to the frame decoder.

requirements.condition: When the Frame Type value is 0x10
requirements.why_checkable: The type-to-frame-name mapping is directly testable.

requirements.condition: When the Frame Type value is 0x11
requirements.why_checkable: The type-to-frame-name mapping is directly testable.

requirements.condition: When the Frame Type value is in the range 0x12 through 0x13
requirements.why_checkable: Both values in the fixed range can be supplied to the frame decoder.

requirements.condition: When the Frame Type value is 0x14
requirements.why_checkable: The type-to-frame-name mapping is directly testable.

requirements.condition: When the Frame Type value is 0x15
requirements.why_checkable: The type-to-frame-name mapping is directly testable.

requirements.condition: When the Frame Type value is in the range 0x16 through 0x17
requirements.why_checkable: Both values in the fixed range can be supplied to the frame decoder.

requirements.condition: When the Frame Type value is 0x18
requirements.why_checkable: The type-to-frame-name mapping is directly testable.

requirements.condition: When the Frame Type value is 0x19
requirements.why_checkable: The type-to-frame-name mapping is directly testable.

requirements.condition: When the Frame Type value is 0x1a
requirements.why_checkable: The type-to-frame-name mapping is directly testable.

requirements.condition: When the Frame Type value is 0x1b
requirements.why_checkable: The type-to-frame-name mapping is directly testable.

requirements.condition: When the Frame Type value is in the range 0x1c through 0x1d
requirements.why_checkable: Both values in the fixed range can be supplied to the frame decoder.

requirements.condition: When the Frame Type value is 0x1e
requirements.why_checkable: The type-to-frame-name mapping is directly testable.

requirements.condition: For a PADDING frame
requirements.required_behavior: Permit the frame in Initial, Handshake, 0-RTT, and 1-RTT packets.
requirements.why_checkable: Each listed packet/frame combination can be submitted to packet validation.

requirements.condition: For a PING frame
requirements.required_behavior: Permit the frame in Initial, Handshake, 0-RTT, and 1-RTT packets.
requirements.why_checkable: Each listed packet/frame combination can be submitted to packet validation.

requirements.condition: For an ACK frame
requirements.required_behavior: Permit the frame in Initial, Handshake, and 1-RTT packets.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not permit the frame in a 0-RTT packet.
requirements.why_checkable: ACK can be placed in each packet type and the validator result observed.

requirements.condition: For a CRYPTO frame
requirements.required_behavior: Permit the frame in Initial, Handshake, and 1-RTT packets.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not permit the frame in a 0-RTT packet.
requirements.why_checkable: CRYPTO can be placed in each packet type and the validator result observed.

requirements.condition: For a RESET_STREAM or STOP_SENDING frame
requirements.required_behavior: Permit the frame in 0-RTT and 1-RTT packets.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not permit the frame in Initial or Handshake packets.
requirements.why_checkable: Each named frame can be placed in every packet type and packet validation observed.

requirements.condition: For a STREAM, MAX_DATA, MAX_STREAM_DATA, MAX_STREAMS, DATA_BLOCKED, STREAM_DATA_BLOCKED, STREAMS_BLOCKED, NEW_CONNECTION_ID, RETIRE_CONNECTION_ID, or PATH_CHALLENGE frame
requirements.required_behavior: Permit the frame in 0-RTT and 1-RTT packets.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not permit the frame in Initial or Handshake packets.
requirements.why_checkable: Every listed frame can be placed in each packet type and packet validation observed.

requirements.condition: For a NEW_TOKEN frame
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not permit the frame in Initial, Handshake, or 0-RTT packets.
requirements.why_checkable: NEW_TOKEN can be placed in every packet type and packet validation observed.

requirements.condition: For a PATH_RESPONSE frame
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not permit the frame in Initial, Handshake, or 0-RTT packets.
requirements.why_checkable: PATH_RESPONSE can be placed in every packet type and packet validation observed.

requirements.condition: For a HANDSHAKE_DONE frame
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not permit the frame in Initial, Handshake, or 0-RTT packets.
requirements.why_checkable: HANDSHAKE_DONE can be placed in every packet type and packet validation observed.

requirements.quote:
ih:  Only a CONNECTION_CLOSE frame of type 0x1c can appear in Initial
        or Handshake packets.
requirements.condition: When a CONNECTION_CLOSE frame appears in an Initial or Handshake packet
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not place CONNECTION_CLOSE type 0x1d in an Initial or Handshake packet.
requirements.why_checkable: Both CONNECTION_CLOSE type values can be tested in Initial and Handshake packets.

requirements.condition: For a CONNECTION_CLOSE frame
requirements.required_behavior: Permit the applicable CONNECTION_CLOSE type in Initial, Handshake, 0-RTT, and 1-RTT packets.
requirements.why_checkable: The frame can be placed in each listed packet type, with the Initial and Handshake subtype restriction tested separately.

requirements.quote:
For more details about these restrictions, see Section 12.5.  Note
   that all frames can appear in 1-RTT packets.  An endpoint MUST treat
   receipt of a frame in a packet type that is not permitted as a
   connection error of type PROTOCOL_VIOLATION.
requirements.condition: When an endpoint receives a frame in a packet type in which that frame is not permitted
requirements.error_behavior: Treat receipt as a connection error of type PROTOCOL_VIOLATION.
requirements.why_checkable: A prohibited frame/packet combination can be injected and the resulting connection error observed.

requirements.quote:
For more details about these restrictions, see Section 12.5.  Note
   that all frames can appear in 1-RTT packets.  An endpoint MUST treat
   receipt of a frame in a packet type that is not permitted as a
   connection error of type PROTOCOL_VIOLATION.
requirements.condition: For any defined frame type
requirements.required_behavior: Permit the frame to appear in a 1-RTT packet.
requirements.why_checkable: Each defined frame type can be supplied in a 1-RTT packet and acceptance observed.

requirements.quote:
N:   Packets containing only frames with this marking are not ack-
        eliciting; see Section 13.2.
requirements.condition: When a packet contains only frame types marked N
requirements.required_behavior: Classify the packet as not ack-eliciting.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not classify the packet as ack-eliciting.
requirements.why_checkable: The packet's ack-eliciting classification can be observed for packets containing only marked frames.

requirements.quote:
C:   Packets containing only frames with this marking do not count
        toward bytes in flight for congestion control purposes; see
        [QUIC-RECOVERY].
requirements.condition: When a packet contains only frame types marked C
requirements.required_behavior: Exclude the packet from bytes in flight for congestion-control purposes.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not add the packet to bytes in flight.
requirements.why_checkable: Congestion-control bytes-in-flight accounting can be inspected before and after sending such a packet.

requirements.quote:
P:   Packets containing only frames with this marking can be used to
        probe new network paths during connection migration; see
        Section 9.1.
requirements.condition: When a packet contains only frame types marked P during connection migration
requirements.required_behavior: Permit the packet to be used to probe a new network path.
requirements.why_checkable: Path-probing logic can be tested with packets containing only P-marked frames.

requirements.quote:
F:   The contents of frames with this marking are flow controlled;
        see Section 4.
requirements.condition: For the contents of a frame marked F
requirements.required_behavior: Apply flow control to the frame contents.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not process the marked frame contents outside flow-control accounting and limits.
requirements.why_checkable: Flow-control accounting and enforcement can be observed while processing marked frame contents.
